name: AFFDF-Financial Assistance For Treatment Of Serious Diseases To Non Pensioner Ex-Servicemen (All Ranks)/Widows
benefit:
> **For Non-Pensioner Officers/Widows:**

- **Medical Treatment Assistance:** Financial assistance of 75% of the total expenditure incurred on medical treatment, hospitalization, medicines, and related expenses.- **Maximum Assistance Limit:** Maximum financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- (one-time) for approved serious diseases.- **Cancer Treatment and Dialysis Assistance:** Financial assistance of
_eligibility_text: - Applicant must be a non-pensioner ESM or his widow. - Should not be a member of ECHS (Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme) or availing AFMS (Armed Forces Medical Services) facilities. - Should be recommended by respective Zila Sainik Board (ZSB). - Expenditure must be incurred at a approved govt hospital at the rates applicable under CGHS (Central Government Health Scheme) / ECHS.
